highlights: close to local schools, amenities and transport links
well maintained gardens front and rear
summary: Nestled at the end of a cul-de-sac in the ever-popular Eastbourne area of Darlington, this exceptional three-bedroom semi-detached home occupies a highly desirable plot with views over green space to the front and the benefit of no passing traffic making it the perfect peaceful retreat for families.
description:
Lovingly cared for and immaculately presented by the current owners, this property has been stylishly updated to create a sleek and contemporary living environment, blending both comfort and practicality in equal measure. From the moment you arrive, it's clear this is a home of quality - with attention to detail evident throughout. Positioned in a prime location, the home is ideally placed for access to local schools, shops, bus and rail links, and major commuter routes including the A66 and A1. With Eastbourne Sports Complex, supermarkets, and green spaces all nearby, this is an address that truly offers convenience as well as curb appeal. Internally, the layout is thoughtfully designed to support modern family life. A bright and welcoming entrance hall leads into a beautifully appointed lounge - a cosy space perfect for relaxation. The heart of the home is the open-plan kitchen and dining area, an ideal setting for everyday meals, entertaining guests, or family gatherings. Beyond, a stylish garden room extends the living space even further, bathed in natural light and offering versatility as a second sitting area, playroom, or home office. Upstairs, three generously sized bedrooms are presented in soft, neutral tones, providing calm and restful spaces. The family bathroom is finished to a high standard with modern fittings and a fresh, contemporary design. Externally, the home is equally impressive. The front garden is landscaped and low-maintenance, while the private rear garden offers a beautifully kept lawn, well-stocked borders, and patio areas for outdoor dining or soaking up the sun. A private driveway provides ample off-road parking, and the rare addition of two garages offers excellent storage or scope for hobby/workshop use. This is a truly turn-key property - ideal for buyers looking for a stylish home in a peaceful, family-friendly location. Early viewing is strongly recommended to avoid disappointment.

ENTRANCE HALL The entrance hallway is accessed via a secure UPVC framed double glazed door, flanked by two full-length side windows that allow for an abundance of natural light, creating a bright and welcoming space. The hallway is beautifully presented with stylish half panelled walls, adding a touch of character and elegance. A staircase rises to the first floor, and a central heating radiator ensures the space stays warm and comfortable. This entrance sets a high standard for the rest of the home's contemporary interior.

LOUNGE The lounge is a warm and inviting space, enhanced by a large UPVC framed double glazed bay window that floods the room with natural light and provides a pleasant outlook to the front. A standout feature of the room is the charming inglenook fireplace, which houses a multi-fuel log burner set upon a rustic tiled hearth, with a striking reclaimed wood sleeper mantle above - adding a natural, earthy character and creating a stunning focal point. Ceiling coving adds a subtle touch of elegance, while a built-in storage cupboard offers practical space for everyday essentials. The lounge flows seamlessly into the kitchen/dining area via open-plan access, making it perfect for modern family living and entertaining.

OPEN PLAN KITCHEN / DINING

The open plan kitchen and dining area forms the vibrant heart of this stunning home - thoughtfully designed for modern family life and perfect for entertaining. To the kitchen, you'll find an extensive range of sleek high-gloss base and wall units, enhanced with integrated lighting that provides both a warm ambiance and practical task lighting. The stylish laminate work surfaces offer generous preparation space, with tiled splashbacks to key areas for both visual appeal and easy maintenance. A stainless steel inset sink unit with drainer and modern mixer tap is perfectly positioned beneath one of the two UPVC framed double glazed windows, allowing in plenty of natural light. The kitchen is equipped with a range of integrated appliances including a fridge and freezer, oven and hob. There is also designated space and plumbing for both a dishwasher and automatic washing machine. The quality wood flooring runs throughout the kitchen and continues into the dining area, adding warmth and continuity to the space. A radiator ensures comfort, while inset ceiling spotlights provide a clean, contemporary finish. To the dining area, there is ample space for a full-sized family dining table and chairs - ideal for everyday meals or special occasions. A further UPVC double glazed window draws in even more natural light, while double glazed sliding patio doors open directly into the garden room, extending the living space and allowing a seamless connection between indoors and out. This room is not only functional but stylish, and truly sets the tone for the rest of the home.

GARDEN ROOM The garden room offers a bright and versatile additional living space, ideal for a wide range of uses - whether as a second sitting room, playroom, home office, or even a hobby or reading area. Thoughtfully extended to enhance the home's footprint, this room enjoys an abundance of natural light thanks to the UPVC framed double glazed side window and French doors that open directly onto the rear garden, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor connection. A radiator ensures the space remains comfortable year-round, while the neutral décor provides a blank canvas ready to suit a variety of lifestyle needs. Its positioning just off the kitchen/dining area adds to its practicality and makes it perfect for both relaxed family time and entertaining guests.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING A bright and airy space featuring a UPVC-framed double glazed window that allows for ample natural light. The landing also provides access to the loft.

BEDROOM ONE A generously proportioned double bedroom, ideal for creating a comfortable and stylish retreat. The space easily accommodates a large bed along with additional furnishings such as bedside tables, drawers, and wardrobes. A UPVC-framed double glazed window allows natural light to fill the room, enhancing the sense of space and warmth, while a wall-mounted radiator ensures comfort throughout the seasons.

BEDROOM TWO A well-proportioned double bedroom offering ample space for additional furniture and wardrobes. This room also benefits from a built-in storage cupboard, which conveniently houses the gas central heating combination boiler. A UPVC-framed double glazed window overlooks the rear aspect, bringing in natural light, while a radiator provides efficient warmth, making this a comfortable and functional space.

BEDROOM THREE A comfortable single bedroom, ideal as a child's room, home office, or guest space. It features a UPVC-framed double glazed window that brings in natural light, a wall-mounted radiator for year-round comfort, and a built-in wardrobe/storage unit offering practical space-saving solutions.

FAMILY BATHROOM This modern and tastefully finished family bathroom offers both style and functionality. It features a contemporary white suite comprising a panelled bath with an electric shower overhead, ideal for both quick morning routines and relaxing evening soaks. A sleek wash hand basin and a low-level WC complete the suite. The walls are finished with a combination of tiling and decorative panelling, creating a clean, low-maintenance, and visually appealing space. Overhead, a panelled ceiling with integrated spotlights adds a touch of modern sophistication. A UPVC-framed double glazed window allows natural light to brighten the room while maintaining privacy, and a wall-mounted radiator ensures warmth and comfort throughout the seasons.

EXTERNALLY The property is set behind a smart and attractively presented frontage designed with low maintenance in mind. The front garden is neatly laid with decorative gravel, creating a tidy and versatile space that's ideal for displaying colourful pot plants, placing a garden bench, or simply adding seasonal touches. It offers a welcoming first impression, combining practicality with charm. To the side, a block-paved driveway provides generous off-road parking and leads to a secure single garage with an up-and-over door. This garage is fully equipped with power and lighting, making it ideal not only for vehicle storage but also for workshop use or general household storage. A gated block-paved path to the side of the house offers easy access to the rear and leads to a second detached garage, also fitted with power and lighting. This additional outbuilding opens up exciting possibilities, whether as a secondary workshop, hobby space, or extra storage for outdoor equipment. The rear garden is a true sanctuary-beautifully landscaped to offer a harmonious balance of functional outdoor living and peaceful retreat. Immediately from the house is a spacious block-paved patio area, perfect for setting up outdoor dining furniture or a summer lounge area, ideal for hosting family and friends. Beyond this is a lush, well-kept lawn bordered by thoughtfully planted flowerbeds bursting with a variety of mature shrubs and perennials, adding colour, texture, and seasonal interest to the space. Nestled discreetly in one corner is a timber garden shed, providing practical storage for tools, lawn equipment, or seasonal décor. Meanwhile, a raised timber decked seating area sits privately toward the rear boundary-surrounded by greenery, it offers a tranquil escape perfect for reading, relaxing, or enjoying an evening glass of wine. This serene nook feels like a garden retreat within the garden itself. Completing the rear garden is a contemporary-style outbuilding featuring an inset window that lets in natural light. Currently used as a games room, this highly versatile structure lends itself to a wide variety of uses-whether as a home office, studio, gym, teen den, or creative workspace-offering a flexible extension of the home that suits modern lifestyles.
